verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents built-in AI. Its pricing page lists 'Generative AI features', and Analytics AI (part of Intuit Intelligence) explains which campaigns and automations drive revenue and gives grounded recommendations. That evidence describes insight and recommendation, not an assistant the user hands tasks to. The 'AI you already use… without leaving the chat' item describes an external AI, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-product assistant that accepts and carries out delegated tasks, detail on what the generative AI features actually do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
